title: Unsymmetrically loaded pin-based portal frame: first-order moments

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.location: Example 9.6, part 2, moment diagram for Eq. 8.1
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Plane (x-y) problem of the source modelled in 3D with the global Y axis vertical, so that the source's x, y and theta_z are the model's X, Y and rz. In-plane bending is about local z for every member (default orientation), hence the source's I is the section's Iz. Units kip, in. a (0, 0), b (0, 24 ft), c (20 ft, 24 ft), d (60 ft, 24 ft), e (60 ft, 0); a and e pinned. Columns ab, ed: A = 13.3 in^2, I = 248 in^4; girder bc-cd: A = 24.8 in^2, I = 2850 in^4; E = 29,000 ksi. Loads: 6 kips along +x at b, 60 kips downward at c, 120 kips downward at d. First-order analysis. Targets: the first-order values of the source's moment diagram (figure labels, in-kips): 316 at b, 8708 at c, 2044 at d. Which label of each pair is the first-order one follows from statics (the column-top moments divided by the 288 in column height are the base shears, and 2044/288 - 316/288 = 6.00 kips = the applied lateral load). Section properties the source does not give because they do not enter its plane model (Iy, J; A where stated) are placeholders that do not influence the targets.

targets.precisionNote: printed "316"; tolerance = half a unit in the last printed digit; figure label (in. kips)
targets.sign: magnitude in the source; statics: the base reaction at a acts along +X (gravity thrust 4.1 kips inward minus the share of the lateral load), giving Mz = +R_x L at the top of ab (local y = +X)

targets.precisionNote: printed "8708"; tolerance = half a unit in the last printed digit; figure label (in. kips)
targets.sign: magnitude in the source; sagging under the 60 kip load = positive Mz (y up)

targets.precisionNote: printed "2044"; tolerance = half a unit in the last printed digit; figure label (in. kips)
targets.sign: magnitude in the source; statics: the base reaction at e acts along -X, giving a negative Mz at the top of ed (local y = +X)
